Subject: Upcoming renewal & usage + open compliance questions

Hi Monica / team,

Quick note ahead of our July renewal: our usage has drifted down ~18% this quarter (see attached incident log and usage notes). Procurement has pushed pause on the renewal while they finish an internal cost-allocation review. They also reopened the security questionnaire (we filled it out last year but a new control owner asked for additional details around data retention and audit logs).

Two immediate asks from our side:
- Can Redwood share the last 12 months of audit-log retention policy and a sample log export schema?
- Is there any flexibility on a short-term extension or credit while procurement completes review?

We value the product but the finance timeline is tight — if you can get an exec-level contact to speak to our CFO this week, that would help.

Attachments: acadia-support-incident-log.pdf, acadia-procurement-questions.xlsx

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Platform Partnerships
Acadia Health
